name: nasa-risk
description: Knowledge pack synthesized from NASA Risk Management Handbook, Version 2.0 (November 2024; NASA/SP-20240014019 Part 1, NASA/SP-20240014326 Part 2): RIDM, CRM, and risk leadership.
